The 
METI 31+ MCGG 82 relay is designed specially for directional control of the time 
delayed element of the over current relay type MCGG, and manufactured by GEC.

This 
procedure details the steps required to completely check the proper operation 
and calibration of the METI 31+MCGG 82 relay.

It is 
recommended this procedure be carried out on a yearly bases. This work be 
carried out section of this document is divided into 3 sections.

The 
first preliminary steps to prepare for relay testing describes the activities 
required prior to testing. Some of these steps could be performed days before 
the actual test. The second section preparation for testing describes the steps 
to set up the equipment for performing the actual tests. The third section is 
the actual test. The document is formatted the way to minimize the possibility 
of error causing personal injury or damage to equipment

The first draft initiated by Abdel Naser Mostafa, tested by 
 eng. Mostafa Ibraheem 
 Ahmed, accepted by general manager eng Shoaqi Mahmod, 
 and approved by eng. Mohamed 
 Mahdy Rezk.

 services.

Make sure CT secondary circuits are shorted at the incoming blocks before 
 isolating the relay current circuits for test

Look at field maintenance file and compare the position of the setting 
 switches on relay with those shown on the setting sheet
Set the earthing link on the relay to line side position

Connect test leads between the current terminals 
 no. (22,28) on the test 
 plug. to the current terminals on the test set for phase "R"

Slowly increase the injection current until reach to the operating value 
 and then the yellow "led" for phase R light. The relay must operate with a 
 current between 10% of the setting value
Record this value "I pick - up" on the test sheet

Increase the injected current with a value 25% larger than "I pick - up" 
 operating value
Slowly decrease the current until the relay resets
Record this value "I reset" on the test sheet
Switch off the test set

Connect leads between time delayed trip out put contact terminal No.`s 
 (29,30) on the relay to the timer (normally open) on the tester

Inject current with a value 25% larger than the operating value "I 
 operate"
Ensure that the relay operates

Switch off the tester set switch on and make reset for the timer on the 
 tester

Switch on the tester unit. Take the time value and must agrees with the 
 setting value on the relay
Record this value on the test sheet

Repeat the above test from step No 1 to 13 for testing phases S,T but 
 inject current between terminals as follow. For phase S terminals no. (24,28) 
 for phase T terminals no. (26,28) on the test plug
